nodes.label: SOLID Architecture Principles
nodes.rationale: Transition from monolithic scripts to decoupled interface-driven architecture for scalability with ML-Agents and multiplayer

nodes.label: Geometry Engine
nodes.rationale: 8x10 grid as central data structure functioning as survival topology for multi-player interactions

nodes.label: Data-Driven Pattern Validation
nodes.rationale: PatternData and VariantData ScriptableObjects define rules; PatternValidator uses normalization and matrix transforms for coordinate-independent shape matching

nodes.label: Survival Calculation Algorithm
nodes.rationale: Flood-Fill simulation treats incomplete groups as conductors to determine if enough empty volume exists; N >= Required_Existing + Required_New

nodes.label: Real-Time Scoring System
nodes.rationale: Differential scoring calculates delta from previousStructureScore to prevent double-dipping; 50pts per die, 150pts per pattern completion

nodes.label: Diagonal Leap Mechanic
nodes.rationale: Conditional expansion of Flood-Fill from 4-way to 8-way scan for patterns requiring diagonal connectivity

nodes.label: Hybrid Interaction System
nodes.rationale: Multi-stage sequence: tap-to-draw, drag/tap-to-place, ghost die visualizer, 2s confirmation buffer

nodes.label: Gap Penalty Dead Zone Detection
nodes.rationale: Orthogonal-only gap penalty prevents groups from escaping through corner gaps; identifies true Dead Zones

nodes.label: DOTween Animation Integration
nodes.rationale: Using DOTween for dice placement animations instead of instantaneous appearance to improve game feel
